response.text: {"question":"As of 28 September 2021, what must a PRA‑regulated UK bank identify and assess regarding a group business service that, if disrupted, could threaten the safety and soundness of the UK group or UK financial stability?","answer":"The bank must identify the service as an important group business service and assess whether it could stay within the impact tolerance during a severe but plausible disruption.","answerable":true}
